items.exampleEn: It typically takes twenty minutes to get there.
items.exampleZh: 到那裡通常要二十分鐘。

items.exampleEn: Patience is an important characteristic of a good teacher.
items.exampleZh: 耐心是好老師的重要特質。

items.exampleEn: Please listen closely to the instructions.
The cat has very sharp teeth.
items.exampleZh: 這隻貓的牙齒非常尖銳。

items.exampleEn: The final selection of players will be made next week.
items.exampleZh: 最後的選手人選下週決定。

items.exampleEn: She gave a brief talk at the start of the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 她在會議開始時做了簡短的談話。

items.exampleEn: The room went silent when the boss walked in.
items.exampleZh: 老闆走進來時，房間裡一片安靜。

items.exampleEn: Put a thin layer of butter on the bread.
items.exampleZh: 在麵包上塗一層薄薄的奶油。

items.sentenceEn: Please keep your phones silent during the show.
items.sentenceZh: 表演期間請將手機保持靜音。

items.audioEn: The shop typically closes at nine, but tonight it will close at seven.
items.audioZh: 這家店通常九點關門，但今晚七點就會關。

items.sentenceEn: Wear a few layers of clothes on cold days.
items.sentenceZh: 冷天時要多穿幾層衣服。

items.sentenceEn: We worked closely with the other team on the event.
items.sentenceZh: 我們和另一個團隊在這次活動中密切合作。

items.stemEn: Please keep your answer ____; we only have five minutes.
items.stemZh: 請簡短回答，我們只有五分鐘。

items.stemEn: The restaurant has a wide ____ of desserts.
items.stemZh: 這家餐廳有很多種甜點可以選。

items.passageEn: Jenny's bakery is famous for one cake. Typically, it has ten thin layers of cream and fruit. Its main characteristic is that each layer has a different flavor. Jenny watches closely as her workers cut the cake with a sharp knife. The shop also has a small selection of cookies. When customers take their first bite, they usually go silent for a moment. Then they smile and ask for more. Jenny's brief answer is always the same: "Thank you."
items.passageZh: Jenny 的麵包店以一款蛋糕聞名。這款蛋糕通常有十層薄薄的奶油和水果。它的主要特色是每一層的口味都不一樣。Jenny 會仔細看著員工用鋒利的刀子切蛋糕。店裡也有少量餅乾可以挑選。客人吃下第一口時，通常會安靜一下，接著露出笑容，想再多吃一些。Jenny 簡短的回答永遠一樣：「謝謝。」

questions.questionZh: 這款蛋糕的主要特色是什麼？
options: 整個蛋糕只用一種水果
每一層的口味都不一樣

questions.questionZh: 客人吃下第一口時通常會怎樣？

items.promptZh: 我們通常九點開始上班。
referenceEn: We typically start work at nine.
Typically, we start working at nine o'clock.
rubricZh: typically 表示「通常」，例如放在一般動詞前、句首等位置
說習慣多用現在簡單式，其他合理時態也接受
「開始上班」可寫 start work、start working 等

items.instructionZh: 用 silent 造一個句子，說說你在什麼情況下會保持安靜。
referenceEn: I stay silent when my boss is angry.
I always keep silent in the library.
rubricZh: silent 表示「安靜的、沉默的」，常放在 stay、keep、be 等動詞後
說的是自己的習慣（主詞用 I）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
